name: VSN Hawker Hunter F.6
summary: VSN team's free Hawker Hunter F.6 for DCS World.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the Hawker Hunter Mk 6. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)

releases.changelog: No version shown; date is when VSN refreshed the download links.
